# **Orange Logic Unveils Orange Builder to Create Brand Sites in Minutes**

Share

* * *

_Turn sketches, PDFs and Figma files into responsive sites using your brand guidelines and governed DAM assets._

NEW YORK--( [BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/))-- [Orange Logic](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.orangelogic.com%2F&esheet=54613178&newsitemid=20260930929679&lan=en-US&anchor=Orange+Logic&index=1&md5=ea8eef246e911ecdfb7e59b49f63cdd4) today unveiled [Orange Builder](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.orangelogic.com%2Forange-builder&esheet=54613178&newsitemid=20260930929679&lan=en-US&anchor=Orange+Builder&index=2&md5=23a2966aaae2b42a91509418da196976), an AI-native builder that turns designs and ideas into working brand sites, portals and microsites in minutes.

Teams can start with a Figma file, PDF, creative brief, sketch or simply describe what they want. Orange Builder builds the pages, follows brand guidelines and sources approved assets directly from [Orange DAM](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.orangelogic.com%2Fproducts%2Fdigital-asset-management&esheet=54613178&newsitemid=20260930929679&lan=en-US&anchor=Orange+DAM&index=3&md5=c323bae1fc7266e7b3b0543c2fbbd394). Its agents handle layouts, create components and visually check the result across desktop, tablet and mobile.

“You bring the vision. AI handles the busywork,” said Karl Facredyn, Founder and CEO of Orange Logic. “Orange Builder dramatically shortens the distance between an idea and something real, giving teams more time to develop their ideas, evolve their brand and bring those experiences to life.”

Teams shape the result through conversation, turn repeated components into reusable blocks and apply shared brand changes across a site. Because Orange Builder draws directly from Orange DAM, assets remain linked to their approved, governed source.

“AI changes the starting point for digital creation,” said Raphael Plaut, Chief Technology Officer at Orange Logic. “Instead of adapting an idea to the structure of a traditional site builder, teams can show Orange Builder where they want to go and let the agent do the implementation work. That changes how quickly an idea can become a real, usable experience.”

Orange Builder can create brand and guideline sites, press and partner portals and campaign and launch microsites.

**Availability**

Orange Logic is previewing Orange Builder at the Orange Logic Summit in New York on September 30, 2026, and inviting select customers to participate in early access. Learn more and see Orange Builder in action at [orangelogic.com/orange-builder](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Forangelogic.com%2Forange-builder&esheet=54613178&newsitemid=20260930929679&lan=en-US&anchor=orangelogic.com%2Forange-builder&index=4&md5=b7f4a4b82c5af8359d4c6a9503aab72e).

**About Orange Logic**

Orange Logic is an agentic content orchestration platform purpose-built for enterprises where content is mission-critical to revenue, compliance and customer experience. Orange Logic unifies digital assets, rights, workflows and governance into a single governed content layer. Trusted by organizations including Amazon, GSK, Bloomberg and Lionsgate, Orange Logic helps teams move content faster, maintain control and turn content into business outcomes.
